title: Bring in the music you already have.
lead: Sonarche reads the folder, copies what it finds into the ark, and keeps the existing tags. Your original files stay where they are.
hint: Nothing is moved: the ark gets a copy.
foundNoneHint: Sonarche found no audio files here. The right folder is the one holding the albums.
truncated: Very large folder: the count stops at 200,000 entries, there may be more.
unplayableKept: They are imported anyway: their tags still count, and they keep their place in their album.
cancelledDetail: Stopped mid-copy. Already in the ark: {{landed}}.
cancelledNothing: Stopped before anything came in. The library is unchanged.
doneDetail_one: {{count, number}} folder added to the ark.
doneDetail_other: {{count, number}} folders added to the ark.
shrinkingWhy: Oversized covers get a display version. The original is kept beside it.
doneRenditions_one: {{count, number}} cover got a display version.
doneRenditions_other: {{count, number}} covers got a display version.

scan.name: Scan
scan.body: Your folder is read, never changed. Sonarche counts what it can read and shows you the verdict before anything starts — nothing moves without your go.

copy.name: Copy
copy.body: Every track is copied into the ark and filed by artist and album, from its tags. When a title is missing from the tags, Sonarche takes it from the filename rather than lose it.

covers.name: Covers
covers.body: The cover comes from the folder, or from the image embedded in the files themselves. Oversized images get a display version, with the original kept beside it.

after.name: What comes next
after.body: The import invents nothing: your existing tags are kept as they are, with no online lookup. To identify albums and fill missing years, genres or covers, run the alignment — offered at the bottom of this page.

recap.clean: Everything is filled in: year, genre, artwork, tracklist.
recap.alignHint: These albums arrive without a MusicBrainz identity. The alignment can identify them and fill the gaps — year, genre and covers included.
